alternate_mechanisms.name: provision-processing audit
alternate_mechanisms.description: Favor and provision enter an accumulating consumption system, become wealth and claims, and return at the end as provision for which an answer is required. Mill, crop, and livestock remain material underlays rather than literal scene elements.

alternate_mechanisms.name: audience-dependent value
alternate_mechanisms.description: Pleasure, kin, chiefs, and the watching collective create an audience for rivalry and display. Certainty and direct verification then replace reputation-based value with unavoidable evidence.

alternate_mechanisms.name: question-to-answer disclosure
alternate_mechanisms.description: What was merely known becomes manifest and actual, then disclosure becomes interrogation and demands affirmation. The final root can therefore carry both enjoyed favor and the response required concerning it.

alternate_mechanisms.name: comparison gaze reversed
alternate_mechanisms.description: Competitive looking can become envy, display, and fascination with appearance; eye-certainty reverses that gaze into direct verification. This preserves an ethical-perceptual underlay without asserting an evil-eye incident.

alternate_mechanisms.name: cluster-to-dispersal reversal
alternate_mechanisms.description: Takathur gathers people and advantages into a dense collective, while death removes the group's competitive coherence and scatters its worldly advantage. Only the social dispersal sense of ن ع م B008 is active, not its zoological image.

alternate_mechanisms.name: temporary lodging and compulsory transit
alternate_mechanisms.description: Hard-driven worldly movement ends in a visit to the graves; pleasant dwelling is exposed as temporary lodging, and burial becomes transit toward the mortal encounter with the Blaze. Walking and hospitality remain figurative underlays.
